verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents dedicated endpoints as private, provisioned instances reserved for your organization, running on capacity not shared with other customers. This delivers the traffic-isolation core of the story. You can upload fine-tuned models from S3 and deploy them to the endpoint, and Prometheus metrics cover endpoint health. However, nothing in the evidence describes autoscaling of dedicated capacity, and the capacity is Cerebras hardware rather than GPUs. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling for dedicated endpoints, capacity sizing/provisioning controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of dedicated deployments.
